name: Staff of Abjuration
description: Usually carved from the heartwood of an ancient oak or other large tree, this staff allows use of the following spells:

name: Staff of Earth and Stone

name: Staff of Illumination
description: This staff is made from ebony or other dark wood and carved into an intricately twisted, fluted, or spiral shape. It allows use of the following spells:

name: Staff of Necromancy
description: Made of thick oak shod in gold, this staff allows use of the following spells:

construction: Strong necromancy; CL 13th; [Craft Staff](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftStaff), [cause fear](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/causeFear.htm), [circle of death](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/circleOfDeath.htm), [enervation](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/enervation.htm), [ghoul touch](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/ghoulTouch.htm), [halt undead](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/haltUndead.htm), [waves of fatigue](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/wavesOfFatigue.htm); Price 65,000 gp.

name: Staff of Passage
description: This potent item allows use of the following spells:
construction: Strong varied; CL 17th; [Craft Staff](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftStaff), [astral projection](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/astralProjection.htm), [dimension door](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/dimensionDoor.htm), [greater teleport](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/teleportGreater.htm), [passwall](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/passwall.htm), [phase door](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/phaseDoor.htm); Price 170,500 gp.

name: Staff of Power
description: The staff of power is a very potent magic item, with offensive and defensive abilities. It is usually topped with a glistening gem, its shaft straight and smooth. It has the following powers:
spells: - [Wall of force](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/wallOfForce.htm) (in a 10-ft.-diameter hemisphere around the caster only) (2 charges)
additional_text: The wielder of a staff of power gains a +2 [luck bonus](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/theBasics.htm#luckModifier) to AC and [saving throws](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/combatStatistics.htm#savingThrows). The staff is also a +2 [quarterstaff](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/equipment/weapons.htm#quarterstaff), and its wielder may use it to smite opponents. If 1 charge is expended (as a [free action](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/actionsInCombat.htm#freeActions)), the staff causes double damage (×3 on a [critical hit](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/actionsInCombat.htm#criticalHits)) for 1 round.

A staff of power can be used for a retributive strike, requiring it to be broken by its wielder. (If this breaking of the staff is purposeful and declared by the wielder, it can be performed as a [standard action](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/actionsInCombat.htm#standardActions) that does not require the wielder to make a Strength check.) All charges currently in the staff are instantly released in a 30-foot radius. All within 2 squares of the broken staff take points of damage equal to 8 × the number of charges in the staff, those 3 or 4 squares away take 6 × the number of charges in damage, and those 5 or 6 squares distant take 4 × the number of charges in damage. All those affected can make DC 17 [Reflex saves](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/combat/combatStatistics.htm#reflex) to reduce the damage by half.

The character breaking the staff has a 50% chance of traveling to another plane of existence, but if he does not, the explosive release of spell energy destroys him. Only certain items, including the staff of the magi and the staff of power, are capable of being used for a retributive strike.
After all charges are used up from the staff, it remains a +2 quarterstaff. (Once empty of charges, it cannot be used for a retributive strike.)
construction: Strong varied; CL 15th; [Craft Staff](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftStaff), [Craft Magic Arms and Armor](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#craftMagicArmsAndArmor), [magic missile](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/magicMissile.htm), [heightened](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#heightenSpell) [ray of enfeeblement](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/rayOfEnfeeblement.htm), [continual flame](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/continualFlame.htm), [levitate](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/levitate.htm), [heightened](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#heightenSpell) [fireball](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/fireball.htm), [heightened](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/feats.htm#heightenSpell) [lightning bolt](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/lightningBolt.htm), [cone of cold](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/coneOfCold.htm), [hold monster](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/holdMonster.htm), [wall of force](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/wallOfForce.htm), [globe of invulnerability](https://www.d20srd.org/srd/spells/globeOfInvulnerability.htm); Price 211,000 gp.

name: Staff of the Woodlands
description: Appearing to have grown naturally into its shape, this oak, ash, or yew staff allows use of the following spells:
